description: Update note fields. Re-embeds if title or content changed. Updates wikilinks if title changed. The server instructions' wikilink and tag rules apply when substantially rewriting — in particular, call list_tags before coining a new tag. Pass expected_updated_at (the updated_at you read) to be refused instead of overwriting a change made in between.

content.description: Replaces the whole body. To add to a note use append_to_note, to change part of one use replace_in_note — both leave the rest untouched

expected_updated_at.description: ISO updated_at from when you read the note; refuses the write if it changed since

folder_id.description: Move the note to this folder; null moves it to the vault root. Omit to leave it where it is

id.description: The note's UUID. Live notes only; a note in the trash has to be restored before it can be edited

tags.description: Replaces the entire tag list — anything left out is removed. To add one tag, send the existing tags plus the new one

title.description: New title. Renaming rewrites every [[link]] pointing here in other notes

name: update_note
